sources: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/250028 (facility record, notices, rules, rates table, and per-site catalog via /api/search/campsites, read 2026-11-20)
Esri World_Imagery at 44.0730,-106.9862 (340 m) and 44.0722,-106.9878 (220 m) with all 18 catalog sites and the stored pin plotted (read 2026-11-20)

values.note: 17 standard sites (35-70 ft, all able to take a 23-ft rig) and tent-only site 16; site 09 is the host's. Sites 01, 11 and 16 are first-come.

sites.source: recreation.gov 250028 catalog (18 units: 17 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' with Max Vehicle Length 35-70, 1 'TENT ONLY'; 01, 11 and 16 'Not Reservable') + notice 'Site 09 is a host site, and it is not available for campers', read 2026-11-20. Stored max 85 ft had no source.

values.note: Hand-pump water. Nearest dump station about 20 mi away on Powder River Pass.

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + recreation.gov 250028 ('drinking water from a hand pump'; 'The nearest dump station is 20 miles away on Powder River Pass'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Memorial Day to Labor Day, weather permitting. After the season closes, a few sites along Forest Road 514 stay open for self-supported camping (no water or trash) while weather allows.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'Memorial Day - Labor Day, weather dependent'; 'Site Partially Closed - Sites and restroom along Forest System Road 514 open to self-supported camping as long as weather permits (no trash collection, water, or cleaning)'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Sites 01, 11 and 16 are first-come; the rest book online at least four days ahead.

booking.source: recreation.gov 250028 (notice 'Reservations must be made at least four days in advance'; catalog 01, 11, 16 'Not Reservable'; maxConsecutiveStay 14) + FS page ('14 day stay limit'), read 2026-11-20

fees.source: recreation.gov 250028 rates (Peak Season 2027-06-04..09-05: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 18.5) + notice ('Two non-towed vehicles allowed per site ... the second vehicle will be charged an extra $9.00 fee'), read 2026-11-20 (the FS page says '$20 per night')

note: Bighorn NF campground at 8,100 ft off Hazelton Road (County Road 3), about 30 mi SW of Buffalo via US-16: lodgepole loops above a meadow where Doyle Creek meanders. ATV trails run next to the campground. No horses. Concession-run (Rustic Freedom). --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-08) + rec.gov 250028: 18 sites (17 standard, 35-70 ft; tent site 16; host at 09), 01/11/16 first-come, the rest reservable 4+ days ahead, 14 days; Memorial Day - Labor Day, a few sites self-supported after; hand-pump water, vault toilets, no dump. rec.gov $18.50 (FS $20). Not waterfront kept (creek lead for 01-02). OHV side noted. Pin fine. Phone empty -> (307) 696-1403.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (kept 'not waterfront'): on a 220-m Esri frame Doyle Creek (a ~2-4 m meadow stream) passes ~40-45 m SW of sites 01 (44.07294,-106.98799) and 02 (44.07280,-106.98768), across the campground access road, a fence line and open wet meadow; 03 is ~55 m and every other site 80 m+ under lodgepole. 01 is first-come, 02 reservable, both sold nightly. Borderline on the ~50 m bar with a road between - left down; a reviewer could make it creekside.
OHV (flag, not a drop): rec.gov 'ATV trails are adjacent to camp'; FS lists 'OHV Trail Riding'. A general FS campground (stays), not a staging area.
FEES: rec.gov $18.50 (2027 table) vs FS page '$20 per night'; wrote the rec.gov figure.
Phone: empty -> (307) 696-1403 (Powder River Ranger District, FS page). The concessionaire line on rec.gov is (307) 431-7446.
Pin 44.07226,-106.98636 is inside the south loop near site 05 - no move (FS point 44.07311,-106.98847 is ~190 m W at the entrance).
Name: rec.gov calls it 'Doyle Creek Campground', FS 'Doyle Campground' - stored name follows the FS; no change.
Website unchanged (FS r02 page and rec.gov 250028 both current).
